claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four will take place on April 4 and April 6, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four will take place at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four marks the fourth time Lucas Oil Stadium has hosted the Men's Final Four.
Semifinal games of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four are on Saturday.
Championship game of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is on Monday.
Semifinals of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four are on April 4.
Championship of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is on April 6.
Horizon League and IU Indianapolis are hosts of the 2026 Men's Final Four.
Tickets and hospitality packages are available through official NCAA channels.
NCAA Men's Final Four events were held at the RCA Dome and Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis in 2010, 2015, and 2021.
